items.title: Phoebe Jacobs and Jackie Harris interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 21, 2006
items.q: the whole transition of like a Herbie Alpert

ctx.x: Phoebe, as a fan of the music, was there time periods when new things were happening that you started to question like —

Oh my goodness yes. I mean I absolutely was horrified to think that people would use six microphones in Carnegie Hall and attach microphones to instruments, to electrify them. The distortion of sound disturbed me terribly. I couldn’t bear it. And also to listen to the way people are playing music these days, the amount of volume, they take all the beauty out of the music. I know when Duke Ellington recorded at Carnegie Hall or Benny Goodman, they used one microphone. Pops only used one microphone. Carnegie Hall…
Yeah it takes the balancing between the group, it takes it out of the musician’s hands and gives it to a sound man.
